verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਪ੍ਰਿਯ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਖੇਲ ਜੈਸੇ  ਪਾਛੈ ਬਧੂ ਜਨਨ ਸੈ ਗਰਭ ਸਮਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: sihajaa sa(n)jog piray prem ras khel jaise  paachhai badhoo janan sai garabh samaavahee ||

en.bdb: Just as a newly wedded bride uniting with her husband on the nuptial bed and after their love making lodges the seed of the child in her womb;

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਅਧਾਨ ਭਏ ਸੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਜਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਜਾਗੈ ਪਰਸੂਤ ਸਮੈ ਸਭਨ ਜਗਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: pooran adhaan bhe sovai gurajan bikhai jaagai parasoot samai sabhan jagaavahee ||

en.bdb: And on confirmation of her pregnancy sleeps in the company of other elderly ladies of the house, and on delivering the child, keeps herself and other elders awake at night;

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਤ ਸੁਤ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਮੋ ਸਜਮ ਕਰੈ ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਸੁਤ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਸੁਖਹ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: janamat sut khaan paan mo sajam karai taa(n) te sut sa(n)mrath havai sukheh dhikhaavahee ||

en.bdb: And on birth of a son, she observes all preventions and precautions in her eating habits so as to ensure sound development of the son who will ultimately become a source of their comforts.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਸਿਖ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ਅਲਪ ਅਹਾਰ ਨਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਸਬਦ ਕਮਾਵਹੀ ॥੫੬੯॥
verses.translit_en: taise gur bheTat bhai bhai sikh sevaa karai alap ahaar ni(n)dhraa sabadh kamaavahee ||569||

en.bdb: Similarly an obedient Sikh of the True Guru serves Him with complete devotion after surrendering himself before Him. He eats and sleeps a little; and in the holy congregation practices meditation on divine teachings of the True Guru. (569)
